title: `justicia expedientes` and
result: Cl@ve login with the certificate (Liferay login, meta refresh to `am.justicia.es`, entity-encoded SAML form, AFIRMA), the "Mis expedientes" cards with their index, and the Atenea IRIS visor tree flattened with the notifications and LexNET receipts nested under each document, each saved with `--out`. Findings: the tree call must be sent minimal (`codOpe`, `codExpediente`, `orden`), since any value for the page's `mostrarTiposDocumentales`/`mostrarSoloDocumentos` flags answers HTTP 902; the check call's `cookie` field is not needed for the download. `justicia.es` joined the host allowlist.
evidence: live 2026-10-15 with Alba's certificate: 4 expedientes; MON 670/2026 listed and downloaded 39 documents (19.3 MB, all PDF; 37 on 2026-10-09); LEV 50/2022 refused with the visor's own message. `pnpm check:ci` passes (1727 tests).
